messages:
Maya Patel: heads up — quick UX check: should our console require an explicit "audit approval" step before enabling automatic fallback with "silent degrade" on customer routes? thinking about ops safety vs speedy mitigation.
Ravi Singh: my +1 is for a small friction: opt-in per-service with audit log and email notify. silent degrade still dangerous if misconfigured.
Kevin Zhou: long-term we want low-latency recovery for customers. can we gate only by risk tier? low-risk routes auto, high-risk routes require approval.
Sylvie Gomez: ops: agree on tiering. also want the decision trace available inline (one-click playback) and a short TTL for auto-deploy so it re-evaluates.
Maya Patel: Sylvie — how short? 15m? 1h?
Sylvie Gomez: prefer 30m to start. also sampling: capture 1% full traces, 10% basic telemetry when silent degrade is on.
Ravi Singh: UI: show a compact banner on route page: "Auto-fallback enabled — last triggered 3h ago" with link to traces and a big red "Revoke" button.
Kevin Zhou: what about API for programmatic control? needs to exist for experiments.
Maya Patel: yep, API exists, but UX should make the default safer. propose: checkbox "Enable auto fallback (recommended for public routes)" then a secondary modal: choose degrade mode [gentle|aggressive], TTL, sampling rate, retention.
Maya Patel: example policy we prototyped:
```
{
  "policy": "auto-fallback",
  "degrade_mode": "gentle",
  "trigger_errors": ["500","timeout"],
  "ttl_minutes": 30,
  "sampling_pct": 1
}
```
Ravi Singh: small nit: make trigger list editable with friendly labels ("5xx errors", "latency spike > 2s").
Sylvie Gomez: and add an "operator override" that records who forced on/off and reasons (free text). This must be immutable in audit logs.
Maya Patel: ok next actions: I can mock a compact route banner and modal. @Kevin can you spec the tier mapping? @Ravi, @Sylvie will you sketch telemetry sampling defaults? we'll sync tomorrow.
deploy-bot: policy cli: `rw policy create --name auto-fallback-demo --mode gentle --ttl 30m`
Kevin Zhou: ack, will do a first pass. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: thanks — keeping this tight. will post mockups in #design when ready :eyes:
